source: PSID 2019, 2021, and 2023 Family File codebooks and questionnaires
evidence_boundary: Listed field names are verified in the relevant wave codebooks. A 2026-09-15 recheck confirms repeated F1A/F1B labels and wording for Reference Person housework and personal care in all three codebooks; cross-wave comparability, universes, weights, missing-value codes, and actual source rows remain to be audited.

codebook_recheck_2026_09_15.finding: All six fields retain the F1A/F1B Reference Person typical-week concepts and the codebooks describe hours per week; this does not establish equal routing, response-code treatment, valid denominators, or retained panel overlap.

fields.questionnaire_label: BC60A typical-week hours spent working for pay

fields.boundary: The 2019 mapping verified here is average commute time; equivalent commute/work-from-home indicator fields still require checking.

fields.questionnaire_label: BC60E feeling rushed or pressed for time while working
F1D typical-week child care and F7 paid child care
fields.note: Annual paid-care and month indicators are verified for all waves; the listed F1D unpaid-care fields are repeated. Exact item universes and 2019/2021 monthly ranges require final extraction check.

fields.questionnaire_label: F7 annual child-care cost and months paid
F1E volunteering, F1G leisure, F1H interaction
F5 days per week family eats main meal together

fields.boundary: Subjective wellbeing is not trust, political action, or cultural meaning by itself.

fields.questionnaire_label: H1 general health and H1A change versus two years ago
Family composition change and interview mode
Constructed annual family utility expenditure and home-insurance expenditure
fields.boundary: These are reported/constructed expenditure measures; they do not identify a causal bill shock or insurance-driven move.

fields.questionnaire_label: Total family money income and constructed wealth including equity
fields.boundary: Income and wealth are resource measures, not liquid cash, buffer availability, or proof of a specific household choice. Wealth variables are imputed constructed summaries and require their accuracy flags.

fields.questionnaire_label: Same field groups and comparable universes
fields.note: The repeated time/care, paid-work, work-pressure, commute-time, family-meal, health, wellbeing, family-weight, paid-care, utility, home-insurance, income, and wealth mappings above are verified or explicitly bounded; remaining detailed expenditure and accuracy-flag fields still require field-level checks.

required_checks_before_estimation: Confirm each variable exists in the target wave file.
Compare question wording, universe, routing, and response codes across waves.
Distinguish zero, not applicable, don't know, refusal, and unavailable.
Record valid person-wave and family-wave counts after every merge.
Preserve survey weights and document the variance method.
Measure retention, mover-out, family-composition change, and item missingness.
